messages.raw: §fHe inspires me to care less about the details, because nothing ever works out in the end.
messages.text: He inspires me to care less about the details, because nothing ever works out in the end.
messages.zh: 他激励我别太在意细节,反正最后什么事都成不了。

messages.raw: §fThey say genius often looks like laziness. Guess I'm living proof.
messages.text: They say genius often looks like laziness. Guess I'm living proof.
messages.zh: 都说天才看起来往往像懒汉。看来我就是活生生的证明。

messages.raw: §fWhen I finally get to it, even §aGranny's §fimpressed with the flavors I whip up.

messages.zh: 等我终于动手时,就连Granny都会被我调出的味道折服。
